description: Defines data structures and classes for a struct-of-arrays table implementation, including row and column views, table management, and row ID handling.

classes.name: row_view
classes.description: A view of a row in a struct-of-arrays table, allowing access to cells by column enum or type.

classes.name: column_view
classes.description: A view of a column in the table, providing access to elements via row ID.

classes.name: table
classes.description: A struct-of-arrays table class managing multiple columns, row insertion, deletion, and iteration.

methods.name: row_view::at
methods.description: Accesses a cell in the row by column enum or type.

methods.name: column_view::has_row_id
methods.description: Checks if a row ID exists in the column.

methods.name: column_view::operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a cell by row ID.

methods.name: table::insert
methods.description: Inserts a new row with provided column values.

methods.name: table::erase
methods.description: Removes a row by row ID or iterator.

methods.name: table::clear
methods.description: Clears all data from the table.
